## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Related issue

Link the issue or discussion, if one exists.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research content or visualization
- [ ] Maintenance or dependency update

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm links:internal`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` for visible or route changes
- [ ] `pnpm links:external` for public source or artifact-link changes
- [ ] Manual checks relevant to this change

If a check was not run or did not pass, explain why:

## Visual and accessibility review

For user-visible changes, attach screenshots or recordings for relevant viewport sizes and themes. Describe keyboard, focus, contrast, motion, and screen-reader checks where applicable.

## Research, model, and compatibility impact

State whether this changes research claims, model metadata, training assumptions, evaluation results, model or tokenizer compatibility, configuration formats, or deployment behavior. Include supporting evidence for factual claims. Write "Not applicable" when none apply.

## Licensing and provenance

Identify newly added code, media, fonts, datasets, model artifacts, copied text, or other third-party material. Provide the source and license or permission for each item. Do not assume that downloadable model weights, tokenizers, datasets, images, or external repositories are covered by this repository's Apache-2.0 license.

## Security and privacy

Describe any security-sensitive behavior, dependency risk, personal data, credentials, or untrusted model/data artifacts involved. Remove secrets, private data, access tokens, and confidential logs before submitting.

## Final checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and documented.
- [ ] Factual and research claims are accurate and supported.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or confidential information are included.
- [ ] New third-party material has a documented source and compatible license or permission.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and changelog entries are updated.
- [ ] Breaking or operational impacts are called out explicitly.
